facebook.caption:
POV: you take a wrong turn in Dương Đông and find a lake nobody in your resort knows about.

Dương Đông Lake sits right in town, rated 4.1★ across 64 reviews, and most tourists walk straight past it hunting for the beach.

Local sports scene, calm water, zero resort crowds. Completely different side of Phu Quoc.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
